Tool Definition: Brings data into the workflow from files or databases.
Configuration Parameters: Connect a File or Database: Recent, Saved, Files, Data Sources, Server. Options: Record Limit, Search Subdirectories, Output File Name as Field, Delimiters, First Row Contains Field Names.

Tool Definition: Writes results to a file (CSV, XLSX, etc.) or a database table.
Configuration Parameters: Write to File or Database: Output File Path/DSN. Output Options: Create New Table/File, Overwrite, Append, Overwrite Sheet/Range. Post-SQL/Pre-SQL: Statements to run before/after data write.

Tool Definition: Displays all data from a connected tool, including data quality profiles.
Configuration Parameters: Data Profile: Shows Nulls, OK, and Not OK percentages. Visualizations: Histograms, Top Values, and Data Type distributions. (No manual input parameters required).

Tool Definition: Allows for manual data entry of a small dataset directly in the workflow.
Configuration Parameters: Grid Interface: Column headers and cell values. Options: Import (allows importing a file directly into the grid), Copy/Paste from Clipboard.

Tool Definition: Provides metadata for all files within a specific folder.
Configuration Parameters: Directory: File path to search. File Spec: Wildcards (e.g., *.xlsx). Include Subdirectories: Checkbox.

Tool Definition: Splits data into two streams (True/False) based on a condition.
Configuration Parameters: Basic Filter: Select Column, Operator (Equals, Is Null, etc.), and Value. Custom Filter: Expression editor for complex logic (e.g., [Age] > 18 AND [Status] = 'Active').

Tool Definition: Creates or updates columns using expressions and functions.
Configuration Parameters: Output Column: Select Existing or + Add Column. Data Type & Size: V_String, Int64, Double, etc. Expression Editor: Box for writing logic using variables and functions.

Tool Definition: Manages columns (rename, reorder, change type).
Configuration Parameters: Selection Grid: Checkbox (Include/Exclude), Field Name, Rename, Type, Size, and Description. Options Menu: Save/Load Field Configuration, Sort on Field Name, Add Prefix/Suffix.

Tool Definition: Reorders records based on one or more specific fields.
Configuration Parameters: Sort by Columns: Select Name (Field) and Order (Ascending or Descending). Use Dictionary Order: Checkbox for language-specific alphanumeric sorting.

Tool Definition: Performs bulk "clean up" of nulls, whitespace, and unwanted characters.
Configuration Parameters: Select Columns: Checkboxes for fields to cleanse. Replace Nulls: Replace with Blanks (Strings) or 0 (Numeric). Remove Unwanted Characters: Leading/Trailing Whitespace, Tabs, Line Breaks, Numbers, Punctuation.

Tool Definition: Separates unique records from duplicates based on specific fields.
Configuration Parameters: Columns to Find Unique Values: Selection of fields to evaluate. Output Anchors: U (Unique) and D (Duplicates).

Tool Definition: Combines two streams horizontally based on common fields or position.
Configuration Parameters: Join Mode: Join by Specific Fields (Left vs Right) or Join by Record Position. Selection Grid: Embedded 'Select' functionality to rename/drop fields from either input.

Tool Definition: Stacks multiple data streams vertically.
Configuration Parameters: Auto Config Mode: By Name or By Position. Manual Config: Allows manual alignment of columns. Output Order: Specify which input stream (#1, #2...) appears first.

Tool Definition: Searches for a string in one stream and replaces it or appends data from another.
Configuration Parameters: Find Section: Search Criteria (Contains, Starts With, Equals), Column to Search, Find Value (from lookup). Replace Section: Replace Found Text OR Append Column(s) from Lookup.

Tool Definition: Performs a Cartesian join (appends every record of Source to every record of Target).
Configuration Parameters: Target (T) / Source (S): Input anchors. Selection Grid: Rename or drop fields. Warn/Error: Allow All Appends, Warn on >16 Records, Error on >16 Records.

Tool Definition: Splits a single string field into multiple columns or rows.
Configuration Parameters: Column to Split: Select Field. Delimiters: Characters to split on (e.g., ,, \n). Split Type: To Columns (Number of Columns) or To Rows. Advanced: Ignore delimiters in quotes/brackets.

Tool Definition: Uses Regular Expressions to parse, replace, or match data.
Configuration Parameters: Column to Parse: Select Field. Regular Expression: Pattern string. Output Method: Match (returns 0/1), Parse (new columns), Replace (string update), or Tokenize.

Tool Definition: Converts string dates to Alteryx format or vice-versa.
Configuration Parameters: Select Column: String or Date field. Convert Mode: String to Date/Time OR Date/Time to String. Format: Select from list (YYYY-MM-DD) or enter Custom format.

Tool Definition: Aggregates data (Group By, Sum, Count, etc.).
Configuration Parameters: Selection Grid: Field name and Data Type. Actions: Add -> Group By, Sum, Count, Max, Min, Concatenate, Longest, etc. Parameters: Separator (for Concatenate).

Tool Definition: Pivots "Wide" data into "Long" data (Columns to Rows).
Configuration Parameters: Key Fields: Columns that stay as they are (ID, Name). Data Fields: Columns to be collapsed into two new fields: Name and Value.

Tool Definition: Pivots "Long" data into "Wide" data (Rows to Columns).
Configuration Parameters: Group Data by These Values: Selection of fields. Change Column Headers: Select field for new headers. Values for New Columns: Select data field. Method for Aggregating: Sum, Average, Concatenate, etc.

Tool Definition: Calculates the weighted average of an incoming data field. A weighted average is more accurate than a simple average because each value contributes based on its "weight."
Configuration Parameters: Value Field (Drop-down): Select the numeric field containing the data to be averaged. Weight Field (Drop-down): Select the numeric field containing the weight (importance) of the value. Grouping Fields (Checkboxes): Optional selection of fields to group by (e.g., calculate a weighted average per City). Output Field Name (Text): Specify the name of the new calculated field.

Tool Definition: Calculates a cumulative sum of a numeric field on a record-by-record basis as it passes through the tool.
Configuration Parameters: Group By (Checkboxes): Optional. Select fields to "restart" the total. For example, if you group by Account ID, the running total resets to zero when a new ID is encountered. Create Running Total (Checkboxes): Select one or more numeric fields for which you want to calculate a cumulative sum.

Tool Definition: Assigns a ranking value (1, 2, 3...) to records based on a specific numeric or alphanumeric field. It is often used to find "Top N" items or to order records within specific groups.
Configuration Parameters: Rank Field: Select the field to be ranked. Rank Order: Choose Ascending (1 = smallest value) or Descending (1 = largest value). Group By (Optional): Select fields to "restart" the ranking (e.g., Rank sales within each Region). Rank Method: • Competition (1224): Items that tie receive the same rank, and a gap is left in the sequence. • Dense (1223): Items that tie receive the same rank, but the next rank follows immediately without a gap. • Ordinal (1234): Every item receives a unique rank based on its position, even if values are identical. • Modified Competition (1334): Similar to Competition, but the tied items receive the highest possible rank in that group. Output Field Name: Specify the name for the new rank column (defaults to Rank).
